A security fix for buckets served through CloudFront, EventBridge notifications for buckets, and fixes for static sites' error pages and `sst dev` with a custom bundle. Still built on upstream [v4.17.2](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.2).

### ⚠️ Breaking changes

- **A bucket with `access: "cloudfront"` can now only be read by CloudFront distributions in your own AWS account.** Before, a distribution in any account could read it through its own origin access control. This covers the assets bucket of every `StaticSite` and SSR site, and buckets routed with `router.routeBucket`. If a distribution in another account reads one of your buckets on purpose, it gets a 403 after you update. Allow it with the `policy` statement shown in the [`access` docs](https://sst-community.github.io/sst/docs/component/aws/bucket#access). ([#79](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/79), [anomalyco/sst#6878](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6878))
- **A deploy role with limited permissions needs `cloudfront:CreateOriginAccessControl`, `cloudfront:GetOriginAccessControl` and `cloudfront:DeleteOriginAccessControl` to deploy a `StaticSite` that has an `errorPage`.** Add them before you update. A site without an `errorPage` needs nothing new. ([#78](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/78))

### New

- **Buckets can publish their events to EventBridge.** `bucket.notify({ eventBridge: true })` turns it on, alone or with queue, topic and function notifications. `sst.aws.Bucket.subscribeEventBridge()` subscribes a function to a bucket's events, filtered by event type and key, including on a bucket SST doesn't manage. ([#85](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/85), [anomalyco/sst#6866](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/6866))

### Fixes

- **A `StaticSite` with an `errorPage` shows that page for a missing path**, instead of a 502. ([#78](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/78), [anomalyco/sst#7025](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/7025))
- **`sst dev` works with a relative `bundle` on a Function**, such as `bundle: "./dist"`. It crashed with `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`. ([#25](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/25), [anomalyco/sst#6253](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6253))

### Docs

- The bootstrap IAM policy lists everything the CLI calls: `ssm:GetParameter` on `/sst/bootstrap`, and on `/sst/bootstrap/asset` to clear an older SST's bootstrap. The reset steps show the command that removes the parameter. ([#81](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/81), [#83](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/83))

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.20.0
```

To switch an existing project:

1. Check that `node --version` shows `v22` or later, wherever you run `sst`, CI included.
2. Set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.20.0"` and reinstall.

For a project that isn't JavaScript, install the CLI globally. It still needs Node.js 22 or later, to run `sst.config.ts`:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
